agentPublishGuide.login: Use an updated SkillHub CLI. Run login and enter registry {{registry}} and your API Token. A web password is not an API Token.
agentPublishGuide.token: Ask an administrator for an API Token. The administrator issues it on the deployment server with this command. Store the token securely.
agentPublishGuide.files: Publish multiple files through the API
agentPublishGuide.pathsFile: Save the following as paths.json in the current directory (UTF-8 without BOM), then run the command. Reading JSON from a file works with Windows PowerShell 5.1 and PowerShell 7.
agentPublishGuide.options: Required: --slug, --name, --kind single|suite, --version. Optional: --summary, --tags "product,design", --changelog, --instructions-file ./USAGE.md (UTF-8, up to 64 KiB). Put the directory or ZIP path immediately after publish.
agentPublishGuide.snapshot: Replace the example placeholders with your own values. Submit a complete snapshot with an increasing version. Only the author can append versions; kind is immutable. Resend optional summary, tags and instructions each time; omitted values are submitted empty. Directory uploads do not preserve empty directories or executable permissions; use ZIP when needed.
agentPublishGuide.shell: Use curl.exe in PowerShell; replace it with curl on Linux / macOS. Replace YOUR_TOKEN, paths and metadata. Each example is one command and needs no line continuation.
agentPublishGuide.protocol: Use multipart/form-data and let curl set Content-Type. Archive mode takes one archive. Files mode repeats files in the same order as the relative paths JSON array. Optional summary, instructions and changelog are text; tags is a JSON array (e.g. ["product","design"]). Do not mix modes.
agentPublishGuide.api_publish: Publish a complete snapshot; Bearer Token required. First publication: 201; new version: 200.
agentPublishGuide.api_list: Public list; q, kind, page and pageSize supported.
agentPublishGuide.api_detail: Public detail; version defaults to latest.
agentPublishGuide.api_versions: Public versions; page and pageSize supported.
agentPublishGuide.api_file: UTF-8 text preview from the selected version.
agentPublishGuide.api_delete: Author or administrator deletion; authentication required.
agentPublishGuide.errors: 400 invalid fields/format; 401 invalid Token; 403 forbidden; 409 version conflict; 413 size limit; 503 unavailable. On a network failure or code=publish_outcome_unknown, check the requested version before retrying. The CLI does not automatically resend.
